metadata.title: Docetaxel Monotherapy 75 mg/m² – 21 day cycle
metadata.indication: Source-defined breast, lung, gastric, gynaecological and castration-sensitive prostate cancer (including high-risk nonmetastatic prostate disease)
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

audited_eligibility: 00203a: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC after prior chemotherapy
00203b: First-line high-risk nonmetastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer
00203d: Advanced gastric / gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma progressing during or within 6 months of platinum / fluoropyrimidine

ongoing: FBC, renal and liver profile before each21-day cycle
source_monitoring.imaging: Response assessment per disease and consultant plan; no fixed CT interval or routine echo/ECG/DXA specified in these monotherapy regimens.

metadata.schedule_summary: Docetaxel 75 mg/m² by IV infusion on Day 1 every 21 days. For the source breast indication, continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity; the team reviews benefit and tolerability. The six-cycle source maximum applies to NSCLC.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Fresh official PDF download; source dose tables visually inspected
source_conflicts: NCCP v7 hepatic table (Giraud-based) differs from Taxotere SmPC hepatic advice. Existing NCCP overlap/gap review remains; no automatic dose is inferred from a mixed pattern.
Taxotere SmPC advises no use unless strictly indicated with bilirubin above ULN, or marked combined transaminase/ALP elevation. Discuss the exact product and NCCP table with pharmacy.

platelets_x10e9_l.assessment_guidance: NCCP 00203 does not specify a platelet dose threshold. Review the full blood count clinically; no platelet-based dose is calculated here.

renal_input.reason: The NCCP source expects no renal dose adjustment, including haemodialysis. This optional value records renal monitoring and is not a Calvert calculation.
